§ 01 · The Program

A complete
curriculum.

Every passage is written for true B1 intermediate learners — richer, longer texts spanning society and everyday life, business and work, travel and culture, technology and innovation, and personal development. Each one is paired with eight carefully written comprehension questions, giving learners the elevated vantage point needed to read English with genuine independence. Built for use inside classrooms, self-study programs, and intermediate English courses.

SURVEY

Authentic content

Every passage reflects real, natural B1-level English drawn from genuinely contemporary topics and ideas.

FOCUS

CEFR-aligned

Structured for true B1 comprehension — longer texts, richer vocabulary, and more nuanced argument than A2.

ANALYZE

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with a clear answer key showing exactly which choice was correct and why.

ELEVATE

Progress tracking

Your completed passages and scores are saved automatically, so you can revisit and improve over time.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Reading Comprehension Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for learners at every level. Vantage takes its name from the elevated view B1 fluency provides — the point where a learner can finally step back and see the whole shape of a text, not just its individual words.

Designed for B1 learners ready for richer, more substantial texts — Vantage is more than exercises. It's a higher point of view: the vantage from which English starts to feel less like a puzzle and more like a genuine tool.
